palettes.rule: Use semantic roles for meaning; never use hue alone to communicate state.

legends.heatmap: incident-count legend is shown when enabled
legends.comparison: textual row labels and values are the legend-equivalent

axes.bar: explicit horizontal scale row from 0 to the visible-slice maximum; the unit and printed value are always present
axes.matrix: columns are labelled tactics and rows are labelled objects

sources.comparison: every comparison card prints DISARM 1.7.0 and links to /data/disarm-provenance.json
sources.rule: a chart without a visible source and provenance link is invalid

units_and_precision.dates: locale medium date; ISO retained in provenance
units_and_precision.precision: preserve source precision; never infer decimals

missing_and_incomplete.visual: no fill plus visible text; never silently coerce to zero

period_comparison.measure: count of DISARM incident records grouped by year_started
period_comparison.output: current-period count, signed absolute delta and rounded relative delta, plus a semantic table alternative
period_comparison.zero_baseline: relative change is shown as n/a when the selected base year has no records
period_comparison.boundary: The comparison covers catalogue records only. It does not measure real-world incident frequency, source completeness, or trends outside the DISARM 1.7.0 snapshot.

maps.source: Natural Earth country reference geometry, reduced to manually reviewed country points on 2026-08-12
maps.semantics: Each marker aggregates DISARM incident country labels. It is a country reference point, not a claimed incident location; World has no arbitrary point and remains list-only.
maps.interaction: marker and list rows filter the same incident set by mouse, touch or keyboard
maps.alternative: visible country/count list with aria labels and pressed state

evidence: comparison rows expose labels and printed values
search and incident results are textual lists
tabular_alternatives.rule: Every visual bar or heat treatment retains a text value and accessible label.
